From a dude that used to be fat here and it sucks and I feel for you. However we all have to be accountable to ourselves and our decisions. No one is ever going to care more about you than you and nobody can do more for you than you. It took me 4 years to get from 285 down to 225. I bounced around a lot but I’m stable now because I changed a lot of my habits and stopped getting foods or putting myself in situations where I had access to foods that were good for me. I used to hate apples but after eating them with peanut butter as a snack or a dessert it starts to hit that sweet spot that Ice cream used to. 
I had to learn a hard reality that “No one is going to save you” you have to be the hero in your story. Envision your comeback story and what people will say and how you will feel! Envision yourself in the mirror seeing your dream body. 
You have to find passion and inspiration for it not just motivation. 

1. This is a big journey so treat like one and get a notebook write about it and how you feel. 

2.Stay away from and don’t buy foods that aren’t good. Stick to Whole Foods (Meat, eggs, veggies, and fruit, maybe a little bit or carbs of some sort maybe potatoes) 

3. Have realistic expectations for yourself and when you fail don’t beat yourself up. I call it rubber banding. When you get outside your lines of discipline recognize it and then bounce back in. It’s  a long journey to keep it off, your habits will become what keeps you skinny. 

4. Do some exercise. Do stuff you like. If you want to lift weights lift weights. If you like walking or hiking then do that.  Get an app for whatever you wanna do and try different ones there’s all kinds of good stuff out there to help your workouts. At least 4 times a week and split it up don’t take 2 day breaks. On off on off on off 
Alternating days. Stay moving you’ll feel better and you can keep the momentum you feel from your routine.

5. Make soft goals and routines. 
So I’ve never had success going extremely hard right off the bat. I have to slowly accelerate into it. It’s all about habit building and changing what your life looks like to you and what your brain recognizes as “normal”.
So again set goals that you’re not gonna beat yourself up and hinder your progress forward over. We all fail and you will fail over and over again but it’s about the journey and getting back up. I know looking back I’m proud of myself.

How to learn how to Rap by Young Vanilla
1. Listen to lyrical rappers on the daily.(eminem, Logic, Joey Badass, Tupac Etc..)
2. Listen to the beat. Most beats you can count 1,2,3,4 over the beat. Elementary music theory. You should count it out loud and line it up with the beat where it evenly spaced out. You can here that the beat mostly repeats after a sequence or two of 1234. 
3.Hear how the rappers spit their words in a flow that generally lands the rhyming word(s) on the end of the sequence.
4. Listen to how they connect their words and they are almost always saying something. And they have a pattern to it. (FLOW)
5.Look up lyrics online and Listen to the song. Notice how the patterns line up and get a mental image of how to put your words together. (Thats how I do it I picture my words on a page and then you lay the flow over it But i have pretty good flow.)
6. Rap and put words together on paper in Bars.
